第679章 唯一真界洪荒天地（第1页）
“吾既已归来，那这虚无便不该存在。”
神话大罗，一念可永恒，是真正的无所不能，万古不朽。
就连整座虚无的规则都因神话大罗的一言而改变。
从太初开始到鸿蒙，六大被祭掉的无量大界化为最为纯粹的本源之力汇聚而来。
太初、太始、太易、太素、太极、鸿蒙。
以及从这六个时代汇聚而来的本源之力。
在神话大罗那浩瀚无穷，无所不能的伟力之下，洪荒天地在升格！
这一过程的变化，肉眼可见，万灵皆能感知。
天地人三道意志：“啊～好舒服啊。”
洪荒升格，万灵受益，但最直接的受益者还是天地人三道意志。
本来，祂们要靠着合体才能达到道尊级别的战力。
最终，三道意志的战力，达到了和万界门扉、始祖星辰、原初之海一样的程度。
未来有朝一日，三道意志也能成为那至高无上的大罗金仙吧。
不过想要从半步大道境的道尊突破至神话大罗的大道境。
此地因神话沧源的记忆与大罗之力衍生而成。
或许三清女娲后土伏羲他们不是真正的神话人物，但……他们也是有血有肉，有情有义，有悲有喜的生灵，是真实存在的。
“等等……他们因我的记忆和大罗之力诞生，那我岂不是他们的……父神？！”

就连道尊、圣人、原始神也不知其中缘由。
前一秒他们还在担心被抓走的沧源的安危。
一袭苍蓝色的道袍是那么的耀眼夺目。
如沐春风的笑容给人无限心安之感。
万道声音，不同的称呼，响彻寰宇，震动无限万域。
沧源笑道：“诸位，苍帝已死，黑潮净散，这场席卷了七大时期的黑潮动乱……结束了！”

Chapter 679 The only true world (page 1)
"Now that I have returned, this nothingness should not exist."
The mythical Daluo, whose thoughts can last forever, is truly omnipotent and immortal.
Even the entire rules of nothingness were changed by Shinhwa Daluo's words.
From the beginning to Hongmeng, the six immeasurable realms that were sacrificed turned into the purest source of power and gathered together.
Taichu, Taishi, Taiyi, Taisu, Taiji, Hongmeng.
And the original power gathered from these six eras.
Under the vast, infinite and omnipotent power of the mythical Da Luo, the prehistoric world is being upgraded!
The changes in this process are visible to the naked eye and can be sensed by all spirits.
The three wills of heaven, earth and man: "Ah~ so comfortable."
All souls benefited from the promotion of the ancient world, but the most direct beneficiary was the will of heaven, earth, and man.
Originally, they had to rely on merging to achieve Taoist-level combat power.
In the end, the combat power of the three wills reached the same level as the Gate of All Realms, the Ancestral Star, and the Original Sea.
One day in the future, the three wills can also become the supreme Da Luo Jinxian.
But I want to break through from the half-step Taoist realm to the great realm of Mythical Great Luo.
This place was derived from the memory of the mythical Cangyuan and the power of Da Luo.
Perhaps Tu Fuxi, the Empress of the Sanqing Dynasty and Nuwa, are not real mythical figures, but... they are also living beings of flesh and blood, with love and justice, sorrow and joy, and they are real.
"Wait a minute...they were born due to my memory and the power of Da Luo, so am I not their...father god?!"
Even Taoists, saints, and primitive gods don't know the reason.
A second ago, they were worried about the safety of Cangyuan who was captured.
The pale blue robe is so dazzling.
A spring-like smile gives people a sense of infinite peace of mind.
Thousands of voices, with different names, resounded throughout the world and shook infinite realms.
Cangyuan smiled and said: "Everyone, Emperor Cang is dead, the black tide has dispersed, and the black tide turmoil that swept through the seven eras... is over!"
